correctness.rationale: All 196785 faces including the empty face are exhaustively generated from the exact 21-vertex 32-edge graph. Replayed acyclic Hasse matching over all 196784 nonempty faces has one critical 0, 59 degree-6, four degree-7 cells. Complete signed Morse boundary has explicit determinant-one 4-by-4 minor; its primitive integral span allows four homotopy cancellations, leaving exactly 55 six-spheres. Bounded integer calculation is exhaustive for the finite object. No infinite extension is claimed.
